import pathlib,json,hashlib,importlib.metadata
roots=list(pathlib.Path('/usr/local/lib').glob('python*/site-packages/Scweet'))
files=[]
for root in roots:
 for p in sorted(root.rglob('*.py')):
  b=p.read_bytes();files.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(root.parent)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'text':b.decode()})
print(json.dumps({'versions':{k:importlib.metadata.version(k) for k in ['Scweet','curl_cffi','xclienttransaction']},'files':files}))
